# Symphony README hero

Updated with the built-in ImageGen tool. The edit references were the previous
Symphony poster and the user-supplied Inbox screenshot. The composition keeps the
rounded posthorn and wordmark, and presents the complete Inbox window after
removing the screen-capture margin and selection outline. This is an editorial
image; it does not define additional implemented product capabilities.

## Prompt

```text
Use case: compositing
Asset type: the existing panoramic Symphony README poster, maintaining a 3:1 wide canvas.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing poster and the edit target. Image 2 is the exact new Symphony Inbox screenshot to insert.
Primary request: replace ONLY the old Board screenshot in the poster with the Inbox screenshot from Image 2. Keep the existing warm off-white background, approved red rounded posthorn, and black "Symphony" title on the left. Preserve the identity and typography.
Cropping and compositing: Image 2 contains a real app window surrounded by a dark screen-capture margin. Extract the app window cleanly, with its complete rounded outer corners, from approximately x=35 to x=1823 and y=10 to y=1129 in the 1871 by 1156 screenshot. Remove every dark outside margin, the thin blue selection outline, and the tiny unrelated sliver above the window. Do not cut into the window. Use the white/light-gray rounded app-window shape as the boundary. No black rectangular backing, no screenshot-selection edge, no halo.
Place this entire extracted Inbox window on the right side of the poster, front-facing and proportionally scaled to fit fully inside the canvas with balanced margins. Preserve its original aspect ratio. Show the complete left project sidebar, central Inbox list, right decision pane, top traffic lights and search bar, bottom status bar, and all four app-window corners. Do not crop the app at the poster's right or bottom edge. The composition may give the screenshot more width and move the left brand block a little to achieve an attractive balance, but preserve the logo and title.
Preserve the supplied interface content and layout faithfully, including "Inbox", "FLAMOX365", the agent assignment options and the delivery-step timeline. This is a compositing request: use the supplied screenshot as the UI image rather than inventing a new interface or redrawing its text. No perspective distortion, stretching or extra duplicate window frame/traffic lights.
Style: crisp native macOS product poster, flat branding, restrained soft shadow outside the extracted window only, off-white/light-gray palette and existing warm red mark. No new slogan, decorations, additional widgets or other branding.
```
